cards.claim: The 371st refers to an Infantry Regiment in the United States military.
cards.quote: 371st Infantry Regiment (United States) The 371st Infantry Regiment was a segregated African American regiment, nominally a part of the 93rd Division, that served in World War I under French Army command, and also in World War II in the Italian Campaign as part of the 92nd Infantry Division (Colored).
